suggested_edits: Both listed sources are unusable here: cwnp.com is the CWNP organisation landing page (certification and class marketing; its only technical asides are a link-margin word-of-the-day and an 802.11n/802.11g band-mismatch question-of-the-day, nothing on data rates), and the Cisco 9800 17-9 config-guide URL returns 403 Forbidden to anonymous fetchers with both the checker's and browser User-Agents. A fix PR should bump version and cite fetchable pages that actually state the claims: a publicly readable Cisco 9800 data-rate configuration page (or vendor equivalents from Aruba, Meraki or hostapd) for the ap dot11 24ghz/5ghz rate commands, per-band RF profiles, the disable-network-first rule and the beacon/multicast lowest-basic-rate behaviour, and a vendor-neutral RF design source for the beacon airtime math, the 30-50 % management-airtime figure, the per-environment rate table, the -67 dBm/24 Mbps note and the legacy-scanner trade-offs. Separately, the protocol cannot represent the blocked Cisco source: listing it makes check --refetch fail on the 403, so blocked-source claims are recorded here as gated with empty quotes and the sources array lists only the one URL actually fetched.
